scope: Component compatibility system in the admin Catalog workspace: a new Compatibility tab (admin CRUD for shared reference values and EQUALS rules), SELECT spec data type with reference-key dropdowns in the full-PC build configurator, a live compatibility banner, and server-side rejection of incompatible builds.

businessFlow.subject: Signed in as the demo admin, opened the Catalog Compatibility tab (renders the seeded reference values socket/memory_type and the three EQUALS rules), then in the PC builds tab picked an incompatible CPU (LGA1700) + motherboard (AM4) and confirmed the live banner and the server-side rejection (build not created), then corrected the CPU to AM4 and confirmed the build saved. Also verified the customer /sell build wizard surfaces the same incompatible-parts warning for a mismatched CPU + motherboard.

notes: Verified headed against the local dev stack (admin :3001, web :3000, api :4000). The compatibility rules and reference values are data-driven (admin CRUD via POST/DELETE /api/v1/admin/reference-values and /api/v1/admin/compatibility-rules); the client evaluates the rules generically (no hardcoded pairs) and the server re-validates on save (422 CATALOG_COMPATIBILITY_CONFLICT). The customer sell build surfaces the same rules as a warning (seller declaration is not a hard block).
